en.headline: Labour Department bars security firm from imported labour applications for two years
en.dek: Jiawei Security Services was sanctioned for altering recruitment conditions without approval, rejecting qualified local applicants and submitting false interview records under the Supplementary Labour Scheme.
body: The Labour Department on Thursday imposed administrative sanctions on Jiawei Security Services Limited, immediately suspending its pending applications under the Enhanced Supplementary Labour Scheme and refusing to process any new applications from the company for the next two years.

Investigators found that while applying to import general clerks and drivers, the firm modified job requirements without the department’s consent, leading at least one qualified local applicant for a clerk post to decline an offer. It also rejected a qualified driver applicant without reasonable grounds and submitted inaccurate interview results to the authorities.

A Labour Department spokesman said employers using the scheme must strictly prioritise suitable local workers. Violations of labour or immigration laws, scheme rules or standard employment contracts can trigger sanctions including suspension of applications, revocation of approvals and multi-year bans on further submissions.

zh.headline: 佳衛保安違規拒聘本地求職者 勞工處禁申外勞兩年
zh.dek: 公司在補充勞工優化計劃下未獲同意改招聘條件、無理拒聘合資格者及提交失實面試資料，遭即時中止申請及兩年禁令。
body: 勞工處周四宣布對佳衛保安服務有限公司實施行政制裁，即時中止該公司已提交的「補充勞工優化計劃」輸入勞工申請，並由即日起拒絕處理其後兩年在計劃下提交的申請。
調查確定公司在申請輸入普通文員及駕駛員期間，未獲勞工處同意下修改招聘條件，導致最少一名合資格文員求職者不接受聘任；另無合理理由拒絕聘用一名合資格駕駛員求職者，並向處方提交失實面試結果資料。
勞工處發言人強調，經優化計劃申請輸入勞工的僱主必須嚴格遵守規定，包括優先聘用合適本地勞工。僱主如違反勞工或入境法例、計劃或標準僱傭合約規定，處方可作出行政制裁，包括中止申請、撤銷批准及拒絕處理其後申請。
